name: Brikama

queries.query: Brikama Gambia cadastral map parcel registry official
queries.result: Official Gambia Ministry of Lands pages and a government land-registration report were found. The report identifies the Department of Lands and Survey as the surveying/cartography custodian and says cadastral maps are available for the West Coast Region, but no current public parcel viewer or parcel API was identified.

queries.query: Brikama Gambia land registry map parcels
queries.result: The official Ministry of Lands site was found, but its current public content is institutional/procedural rather than a parcel map. The official National Land Policy says the land-record system remains fragmented and paper-based and calls for a future integrated LIS; no public parcel endpoint was evidenced.

registryCustodian: The Gambia Ministry of Lands and Regional Government / Department of Lands and Survey; local context is Brikama Area Council, but no Brikama-local public parcel service was evidenced.

requestOutcomes.outcome: HTTP 200; current WordPress HTML and linked assets inspected. No public map viewer, parcel layer, ArcGIS REST endpoint, WFS, or parcel configuration was exposed.
HTTP 200; land-related institutional page(s) returned, including the Land Commission page; no parcel geometry or safe parcel-ID service was exposed.
HTTP 200; official ministry directory identifies Department of Lands and Survey and Department of Physical Planning, but no public parcel service link was present.
